purpose: Verified contract for citizen-facing evidence drill-down from an approved property timeline event.
record_rule: Record identity and record scope are displayed separately from extracted facts.
matching_rule: Material property and date matches are retained and visible.
legal_effect_rule: Legal effect is shown only when supported by applicable authority and evidence.
date_rule: Event, document, registration and legal-effect dates remain distinct.
document_rule: Document existence does not by itself establish registration or legal effect.
source_rule: Citizen-supplied documents remain labelled until independently validated.
access_rule: Restricted records are summarized only within permitted access.
limitation_rule: Material evidence and legal limitations remain visible.
verification_boundary: The drill-down exposes approved evidence lineage and legal context; it does not create new facts or legal conclusions.
